title: SEC2: New hyper Client built on every fetch miss
description:
fetch_peer_blob builds a fresh hyper Client on every single download miss.

File: crates/kithd/src/peer_fetch.rs, line 375

The Client is stateless and reusable. Building it per-request prevents connection pooling/reuse and wastes TLS handshake overhead for repeated fetches to the same peer.

Impact: Measurable on high-volume attachment downloads. Refactor to build once at daemon startup (AppState) and share across all peer fetches.
